description: Add a window to an existing straight wall at t (0..1 along it), centred vertically on the wall, or on sillHeight above the floor when given. It slides to stay on the wall and under the wall's ceiling, and reports clamped. Refused with a code, as in the editor: curved walls, railings (railing_window: a railing takes a door, a gap in its guard), walls shorter than the window, overlapping another door, window or wall item unless force is set, and a style on a window that is not Fixed (style_needs_fixed_window). Match the reference with the outline (rectangle, rounded, arch), windowType and panes (columns × rows, or a style); what they cannot express (glass strips, leaded lites, a feature frame) is written as a script in code, never left as not possible. Not available in run_batch: the host opening executor prepares scripted creation and rebuilds, which a batch does not prepare.

archHeight.description: Rise of the arch above its straight sides, within height (arch only; default 0.35 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

category.description: What this design is, in one or two words.

code.description: An optional module (three.js, or bpy with language) for a window (a fan grille, tracery, carved trim): the same module and conventions as add_object, with mount 'wall'. Its size is what it builds (name params width and height so the window's size controls edit them), and its cutout mesh cuts the wall. Make it open like a real window: add an `open` clip (the sash sliding or swinging; `close` is optional, `open` reversed by default) unless it is fixed. Native fields and code are available to express the requested shape.

columns.description: Panes across each operable sash (the whole fixed window), equal widths; overrides the style's panes.

cornerRadius.description: Radius of the rounded top corners (rounded only; default 0.15 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

description.description: A short description of this design, at most 200 characters.

force.description: Place it even where it overlaps another door, window or wall item, like holding Alt in the editor. Only when the person asks for the overlap.

height.description: Window height (default 1.5 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

hingesSide.description: Casement or tilt-turn side hinges (default left).

language.description: The code's language: 'three' (default) for a three.js module, 'bpy' for a Blender module (see add_object). On an edit it defaults to the language the object was built in.

name.description: What the user would call this design.

nodeId.description: Rebuild this window instead of adding one: new code and/or params (get_source provides current code when needed). Its native fields change with update_node.

openingDirection.description: Casement or awning swing toward exterior or interior, independent of placement (new windows default outward). Ignored by hopper and tilt-turn, which open inward.

openingShape.description: Outline of the opening: rectangle (default), rounded top corners, or arch (round top).

params.description: Values for the params the module declares; on an edit, each one you leave out keeps its current value (clamped to the param's range) and a param new to the code starts at its default.

rollerShutter.description: Roller mount (default none): box on the exterior face above the opening, or concealed with a 0.03 m lintel strip and 0.025 x 0.03 m guides inside the reveal. Concealed curtain sits 0.02 m outside the frame plane, width minus 0.05 m.

rollerShutterBoxHeight.description: Exterior roller box height (default 0.18 m); used only by the box mount. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

rollerShutterOpen.description: Static roller curtain position: 0 down, 1 fully up (default 1), independent of operationState.

rows.description: Panes up each operable sash (the whole fixed window), equal heights; overrides the style's panes.

sashGrid.description: Pane grid per operable sash (default false; columns or rows enable it).

shutterOpen.description: Exterior shutter position: 0 closed over the window, 1 open (default 1). Leaves over 0.75 m fold into two stacked halves; narrower leaves open flat against the wall.

shutterSides.description: Which exterior shutter leaves to build (default both).

shutterWidth.description: Width per side, uncapped: defaults to half the opening for both sides, full opening for left or right only. Widths over 0.75 m form a bifold pair of equal halves. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

shutters.description: Exterior shutters (default none), with a 10 mm overlap lip on one leaf when both sides are present.

sillHeight.description: Height from the floor to the bottom of the window (default: centred vertically on the wall). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Minimum 0 m.

sillInterior.description: Add a stool board on the room side (default false).

sillInteriorDepth.description: Interior stool depth (default 0.06 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

sillInteriorOverhang.description: Interior stool extension beyond casing on each side (default 0.015 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Minimum 0 m.

sillInteriorThickness.description: Interior stool thickness (default 0.03 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

sillOverhang.description: Exterior sill extension on each side; default 0.4 times sillDepth. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Minimum 0 m.

style.description: Visual preset of a Fixed window's panes (never the size); same presets as create_room windows[]. Fixed windows only: an operable window draws its own sashes.

t.description: Position along the wall, 0..1: 0 = start, 0.5 = centre, 1 = end.

tags.description: Up to five short lowercase search tags, at most 32 characters each.

tiltTurnMode.description: Tilt-turn only: tilt inward about the bottom up to 15 degrees (default), or turn inward about the side hinges up to 90 degrees.

wallId.description: The wall to add the window to.

width.description: Window width (default 1.5 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

windowHandle.description: Show the interior sash handle (default true).

name: add_window
title: Add window
